pattern: (either|at least one of)\W+`click_id`\W+or\W+`customer_key`|outside test mode, provide at least one of|pass `customer_key` or `click_id` to identify|or the `customer_key` set at signup
why: Lead rule: send the click_id on every lead. A first lead with only customer_key answers 400 Customer not found, because the key is saved on the customer only when a lead settles. The sale rule (`customer_key` or `click_id`) is unchanged and not matched.

pattern: at least one of `customerExternalId` or `clickId` is required(?!, and `amount`)|optional but improves binding
why: trackLead: the SDK throws only when both are missing; a first lead without clickId returns ok: false, status 400. The trackSale sentence ("is required, and `amount` ...") is still true and not matched.
Refunds: a partial refund reduces a commission already approved and cancels one still pending whole. Say which, not "reduced proportionally".
subscription_id is only stored with the sale; it plays no part in finding the customer or in the commission.

pattern: need both locations|in \*\*(both\*\* places|two places\*\*)|both `metadata` and `subscription_data\.metadata`
why: Subscriptions need subscription_data.metadata: their payments are read from invoices, which carry the subscription's metadata, not the session's. The session metadata is not also required.
affitor onboard has no verify subcommand; `npx affitor onboard` itself fires the synthetic chain.
Not every checkout field is required: program_id is Recommended and affitor_click_id may be empty on repeat purchases.
deductionAmount is the commission share a refund covers. For a pending commission it is informational (the commission is cancelled whole) and nothing leaves the partner's balance.
Without the click id, a first trackLead answers 400 Customer not found and no lead is recorded.
A renewal sent with trackSale while Stripe is connected is refused as a duplicate (same invoice id); the real risk is that a Stripe refund does not reverse its commission.
The customer record is created at the partner click; signup saves your customer_key on it when the lead settles. The browser helper is signup(customerKey, email), not an object.
Recurring earns until the months in For have passed since the customer's first click on the partner link, not for N payments or N months after signup; later payments get a $0 commission.

pattern: no customer record exists|accept that the lead will be unattributed|lead is still recorded \(unattributed\)|unattributed unless you pass `customer_key`
why: The customer is created at the click; a lead without a click answers 400 and records nothing, and customer_key alone cannot recover attribution (it is saved only when a lead settles).
